# The Brand Voice AI

A solo fractional marketing consultant with 20+ years of hands-on business experience helping product-based and founder-led companies build strategic, consistent marketing systems. The brand voice is direct, empathetic, and no-nonsense — speaking to busy business owners who are overwhelmed by marketing chaos. The positioning is anti-tool, anti-generic-AI, and pro-human expertise, emphasizing real-world practicality over theoretical strategy. The consultant's unique edge is deep operational experience across marketing, sales, operations, and fulfillment, allowing them to build systems that actually work in resource-constrained environments.

## How I Help


Practical marketing consulting services that build systems, not just noise.








### Fractional Marketing Leadership


Get strategic marketing guidance without the cost of a full-time marketing director. Together, we'll clarify priorities, identify opportunities, and create a practical marketing roadmap that supports your business goals.

### Brand Voice Development


Your company has a unique story, expertise, and personality. I'll help you define and document a brand voice that creates consistency across your website, social media, emails, and customer communications.


Outcome: A documented brand voice guide that ensures every piece of content sounds like you, not a generic template.












### AI Content Systems


Most businesses are using AI backwards — asking it to create content before teaching it how their brand sounds. I build customized AI content systems that help you create content faster while maintaining the human expertise your audience trusts.


Outcome: AI that sounds like your business, not a robot. Faster drafting, consistent voice, and content that reflects your actual expertise.












### Content Strategy & Execution


Move from reactive posting to a repeatable content system tied directly to your sales goals. I help you plan, create, and manage content across LinkedIn, email marketing, customer stories, blogs, case studies, product messaging, and sales enablement.


Outcome: A content calendar that actually gets executed, content that supports every stage of your sales process, and a system you can maintain.

# Marketing Leadership for Businesses That Need Growth—Not Another Marketing Tool


A fractional marketing partner who replaces chaos with calm, practical systems grounded in 20+ years of hands-on business experience.


This isn't outsourced fluff. It's strategic, human-led marketing leadership designed for founder-led and product-based companies that need clarity, consistency, and a brand voice that actually sounds like them.










What Clients Usually Struggle With


- Inconsistent content that confuses customers

- Unclear messaging that dilutes brand trust

- Generic AI-generated copy that lacks personality

- Reactive marketing with no strategic rhythm

- Overwhelm from too many tools and no system









What This Engagement Creates


- A clear, documented brand voice that guides every message

- Consistent content that builds recognition and trust

- Practical AI systems that amplify your expertise, not replace it

- A strategic marketing roadmap aligned with business goals

- Calm confidence from having a simple, repeatable system







Explore How We Can Work Together

## How We Build Your Marketing System


A practical, four-step process designed for busy founders and lean teams. No fluff, no generic AI templates — just a clear path to a consistent, confident brand voice.




01

### Clarify What's Broken


We start with a focused audit of your current marketing: messaging gaps, inconsistent content, and the reactive habits that keep you stuck. You'll get a clear, prioritized list of what to fix first.






02

### Define Voice & Messaging


Together, we document your brand's unique personality, core messages, and audience language. You'll walk away with a brand voice guide that makes every piece of content sound unmistakably like you.






03

### Build the Content System


We design a repeatable content engine — from AI-assisted drafting to editorial calendars — that fits your team's actual capacity. No more scrambling for what to post next.






04

### Establish Execution Rhythm


We set a realistic publishing cadence, assign lightweight ownership, and create simple feedback loops. This turns your marketing from a source of stress into a manageable weekly habit.

### Consistency Without the Burnout


Build a sustainable marketing rhythm that doesn't rely on you burning the midnight oil. A documented system means your content shows up week after week, building trust while you focus on running the business.








### Confidence in Your AI Tools


Most teams use AI backwards, getting generic results that erode trust. We build custom AI content systems trained on your brand voice, so you can create faster without sounding like everyone else.

# Marketing leadership that understands the full picture



I'm a solo fractional marketing consultant who has spent more than two decades inside growing companies — not in agencies, not in theory, but in the thick of real business. That means I've lived through the chaos of limited budgets, stretched teams, and the constant tension between what marketing should look like and what's actually possible when you're running a company.



My experience spans marketing, sales, operations, fulfillment, and customer relationships. I don't just hand you a strategy document and walk away. I build systems that connect all those dots — because marketing doesn't work in isolation. It has to fit your team's capacity, your fulfillment reality, and your customers' actual experience. That's the only way it becomes something you can sustain.


Guided by:
Practical strategy, human expertise, and marketing systems that actually work in resource-constrained environments.















## The Story Behind the Strategy




01


### Understanding Overloaded Businesses from the Inside


Having spent over two decades inside product-based and founder-led companies, I've seen the same pattern repeat itself: brilliant operators who know their products, their customers, and their industry — yet marketing consistently falls to the bottom of the list. Not because it isn't important, but because the daily demands of running a business leave no bandwidth for strategic marketing work.


This isn't a failure of effort. It's a structural reality. When you're simultaneously managing operations, sales, fulfillment, and customer service, marketing becomes reactive by necessity. The result is inconsistent content, unclear messaging, and a nagging sense that your brand voice isn't landing the way it should.











02


### Why Generic Marketing Advice Fails in Resource-Constrained Environments


Most small business marketing consulting services offer playbooks built for companies with dedicated teams, generous budgets, and the luxury of time. But when you're a team of five — or a team of one — those playbooks fall apart. Generic AI tools compound the problem, producing copy that sounds like everyone else because no one taught the machine how your brand actually speaks.


I've watched talented founders waste months chasing tactics that their operations couldn't support. The gap isn't knowledge — it's translation. The best strategy in the world is worthless if your business can't realistically execute it with the resources you actually have.







"Strategy only matters if a business can realistically use it."


Core Philosophy









03


### Building Systems That Fit Actual Operations


The turning point comes when marketing stops being another item on the to-do list and becomes a system that runs alongside the business. Drawing on deep operational experience across marketing, sales, and fulfillment, I help founder-led companies build practical marketing rhythms — content systems, brand voice documentation, and AI workflows that actually reflect how the business works day-to-day.


This isn't about adding complexity. It's about subtraction: removing the noise, clarifying the message, and creating repeatable processes that a lean team can sustain. When your marketing system fits your operations, consistency stops being a struggle and starts being a habit.
















## Who I Work With


Marketing consulting services for businesses that know their craft but need a clearer way to talk about it. My clients share a common thread: deep operational expertise, inconsistent marketing, and limited bandwidth.








### DTC Brands


You've built a great product and a loyal customer base, but your marketing feels reactive. You need a consistent voice that scales beyond one-off campaigns.







### Manufacturers


Your shop floor runs like clockwork, but your story gets lost in technical jargon. Together we translate operational excellence into compelling market narratives.







### Printers & Print Service Providers


You deliver tangible quality every day, but digital marketing feels foreign. I help you build a practical marketing system that matches the reliability of your print output.







### Product-Based Businesses


Your product speaks for itself on the shelf, but online it needs a clear, consistent voice. Let's build the messaging framework that turns browsers into buyers.







### Founder-Led Companies


You're the face of the business, but you can't be everywhere. I help you systematize your voice so your marketing works even when you're focused on operations.





These businesses don't need another marketing tool or generic AI content. They need a practical marketing system that respects their expertise, protects their brand voice, and fits within the reality of limited time and resources. That's where I come in.











## How I Work







### No Generic Advice


Every business has a unique rhythm of operations, sales, and fulfillment. I don't believe in one-size-fits-all playbooks. The strategies we build together will respect your specific constraints, resources, and the real people you serve — because marketing that ignores how your business actually runs is just noise.








### No Blind Trust in Tools


AI and automation are powerful, but they can't replace human judgment. I help you implement technology thoughtfully — teaching AI your brand voice rather than letting it write generic copy. We use tools as levers for consistency, not as crutches that erode the authentic connection you've built with your customers.








### No Strategies That Ignore Reality


The best marketing system is the one your team can actually sustain. I focus on practical, operational systems that fit into your existing workflows. As a fractional marketing consultant with deep experience across sales and fulfillment, I design approaches that work in resource-constrained environments — because theory doesn't pay the bills.















## Ready to build a marketing system that actually works?


If your messaging feels unclear, your content creation is inconsistent, and AI tools are producing generic copy that doesn't sound like your brand, you're not alone. Most founder-led businesses face the same challenge — not because marketing isn't important, but because you're busy running a business. Let's change that with practical marketing leadership, a clear brand voice, and AI content systems grounded in real human expertise.

Start the Conversation




No pressure, no pitch decks — just a practical conversation about your marketing.

# Privacy Policy



Last Updated:  6/11/2026



The Brand Voice AI ("Company", "we", "our") is committed to protecting your privacy. This privacy policy explains how we collect, use and protect your information when you use our website [business_website] ("Service").


## 1. Information Collection


We may collect the following types of information:


- Personal Information: Name, email address, phone number and address

- Technical Information: IP address, browser type, operating system and website usage data

- Cookies: Information stored on your computer to improve user experience




## 2. Use of Information


We use the collected information for the following purposes:


- Providing requested services

- Improving service and user experience

- Contacting you regarding our services

- Compliance with legal requirements




## 3. Information Sharing


We do not sell, rent or share your personal information with third parties, except in the following cases:


- With your explicit consent

- When required by law

- To protect our rights or user safety

- With service providers who assist in operating the service (under confidentiality agreements)




## 4. User Rights


In accordance with Israeli Privacy Protection Law 1981, you have the following rights:


- Right to access personal information stored about you

- Right to correct inaccurate or incomplete information

- Right to delete personal information in certain circumstances

- Right to object to information processing for marketing purposes

- Right to file a complaint with the Data Protection Authority




## 5. Cookies


Our website uses cookies to improve user experience. You can manage cookies through your browser settings. Disabling cookies may affect website functionality.


## 6. Information Security


We implement reasonable security measures to protect your information, including encryption, firewalls and restricted access control. However, no transmission or storage method is 100% secure.


## 7. Policy Changes


We may update this privacy policy from time to time. Material changes will be posted on the website with 30 days advance notice.



## 8. Contact Information


For questions or requests regarding this privacy policy, please contact us:


- Company: The Brand Voice AI

- Email: [business_email]

- Phone: [business_phone]

- Address: [business_address]



Data Protection Authority: For complaints, you may contact the Data Protection Authority at the Ministry of Justice

# Accessibility Statement



Last updated:  June 11, 2026



The Brand Voice AI is committed to making our services accessible to all users. We strive to implement the Israeli Standard (TI 5568) based on WCAG 2.1 Level AA guidelines.


Accessibility Level: AA (Israeli Standard TI 5568)



## 1. Accessibility Policy


We believe in equal rights and the right of every person to receive information and services independently and equally. This website was designed and built with special emphasis on accessibility for people with disabilities.


## 2. Accessibility Arrangements on the Site


- Keyboard navigation support

- Screen reader compatibility

- Appropriate color contrast

- Flexible and scalable font sizes

- Descriptive image alt text

- Hierarchical heading structure

- Clear and descriptive links

- Support for 200% zoom without content loss





### WCAG 2.1 Compliance


The website complies with WCAG 2.1 Level AA, which includes:


- Perceivable: Information is presented in ways users can perceive

- Operable: Interface components are operable

- Understandable: Information and user interface are understandable

- Robust: Content can be interpreted by a variety of technologies





## 3. Supported Assistive Technologies


- NVDA (Windows)

- JAWS (Windows)

- VoiceOver (Mac/iOS)

- TalkBack (Android)

- Dragon NaturallySpeaking

- Switch navigation




## 4. Accessibility Testing


The website has been tested using:


- Automated accessibility testing tools

- Manual testing with screen readers

- Keyboard-only navigation

- Color contrast verification

- Testing with users with disabilities




## 5. Continuous Improvements


We are continuously working to improve the accessibility of our website and update it according to technological developments and user feedback.



## 6. Contact and Feedback


If you encounter an accessibility issue on the site or need assistance, please contact us:


- Company: The Brand Voice AI

- Email: [business_email]

- Phone: [business_phone]



Response time: We respond to accessibility inquiries within 3 business days and work to resolve issues within 10 business days.
